title: Return Record and the Consolidation Move Limit — Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
**Clause.** The holder's Returns & Exchanges return record changes the move limit of a Gift Cards & Store Credit consolidation of value carried onto a card by replacement: when none of the holder's returns had a line authorized in the last 12 months, 10.00 is added; when lines were authorized on returns 3 or more times in that window, 25.00 is taken off, never below zero; otherwise the move limit is not changed. The amount is added to, or taken off, the move limit after the move limit's application for the age of the stolen or lost card.

**Reading the clause.**

- *Window.* Return lines authorized on the holder's returns, dated fewer than 12 whole months before the consolidation date.
- *Unit counted.* Each return line authorized counts once; three lines authorized on a single return count as three.
- *Floor.* The reduction never takes the move limit below zero.

**Condition, judgement, result** (hypothetical move limit of 90.00 after its application for card age):

> No line authorized in the window: clean record, 10.00 added, move limit 100.00.
>
> One or two lines authorized: neither clean nor heavy, no change, move limit 90.00.
>
> Three lines authorized: heavy record, 25.00 taken off, move limit 65.00.
>
> Three lines authorized against a move limit of 20.00: 25.00 taken off stops at zero, move limit 0.00.
